gripOrHq.title: HQ Interface
gripOrHq.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

gripOrHq.title: Replicator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [0]: Break ice subroutine that traces. [1]: +1 strength.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Armored Fridge
heapOrArchives.rulesText:
Put seven Ablative counters on Armored Fridge when it is installed. When the last Ablative counter has been removed, trash Armored Fridge.
Ablative counter: Prevent 1 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Clown
heapOrArchives.rulesText: All ice is encountered with its strength reduced by 1.

scoreArea.title: Charity Takeover
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [9] and 1 Bad Publicity point. If the Corp has 7 or more Bad Publicity points, it loses the game, even if it fulfills victory conditions at the same time.

scoreArea.title: Please Don't Choke Anyone
scoreArea.rulesText: For each 1 damage you successfully do, you may choose instead to prevent that damage and put a PDCA counter on Please Don't Choke Anyone. PDCA counter: Gain an action. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.

rig.title: Expert Schedule Analyzer
rig.rulesText: After you access cards from HQ, look at all cards stored in HQ.

rig.title: Snowball
rig.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

rig.title: Aujourd’Oui
rig.rulesText: A: Look at the top five cards of your stack. You may bring any program cards among them into your hand. Pay [1] for each card taken in this way, and show those cards to the Corp. Shuffle your stack.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Please Don't Choke Anyone
scoreArea.rulesText: For each 1 damage you successfully do, you may choose instead to prevent that damage and put a PDCA counter on Please Don't Choke Anyone. PDCA counter: Gain an action. Use this ability only once per turn and only during your turn.

scoreArea.title: Marked Accounts
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Marked Accounts, give Runner a tag, even if it is not installed. If Marked Accounts is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

ice.title: Homing Missile
ice.rulesText: *Trace x-If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot make another run until Runner takes an action to pay [2]. Pay X, above the rez cost, when you rez Homing Missile. X is Homing Missile 's strength and trace limit, and X cannot be greater than 8.

ice.title: Caryatid
ice.rulesText: *End the run. When you rez Caryatid, you may pay [1], above the rez cost, to make it a code gate instead of a wall.

root.title: Minotaur
root.rulesText: For each rezzed code gate or wall installed outside Minotaur, Minotaur has one "*End the run" subroutine.

root.title: Rent-to-Own Contract
root.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put on that ice a number of Term counters equal to its rez cost. At the start of each of your turns, if you have at least [2], lose [2] and remove one of these Term counters; otherwise, put a Term counter on that piece of ice.

root.title: Datacomb
root.rulesText: *End the run. If Runner passes Datacomb, pay [1], or uninstall it and store it in HQ.

root.title: Bug Zapper
root.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.

root.title: Digiconda
root.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage. *End the run. Pay [X], above the rez cost, when you rez Digiconda. X is Digiconda 's strength, and X cannot be greater than 6.

root.title: Sandstorm
root.rulesText: Sandstorm has one "*End the run" subroutine for every [2] you pay, above the rez cost, when you rez it.

root.title: Emergency Rig
root.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put X Kludge counters on that piece of ice; X cannot be 0. At the start of each of your turns, remove a Kludge counter. Trash that piece of ice when the last Kludge counter is removed from it.

removedFromGame.title: MIT West Tier
removedFromGame.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.
